hypothesis: Running a small ensemble of decoding variants (one greedy + three low-temperature draws) from the champion adapter and selecting the most coverage-diverse set should push past the adapter's single-draw ceiling, because the adapter already has strong per-question quality and the bottleneck is topical spread across the 7 questions.
technique: Four parallel on-device calls through the champion adapter — one greedy draw and three low-temperature stochastic draws — followed by deterministic Swift selection of the candidate set that maximises embedding coverage-volume plus relevance, with no additional model involvement in the selection step.
result: Scored 0.398 on the full-30 gate (2 wins / 4 ties / 22 losses vs Sonnet), with specPass 100% and rubric scores atom=4, spec=3, cover=3, nat=3, nonRed=4. Coverage stayed at 3 despite the dispersion strategy, meaning the ensemble selection did not break through the coverage plateau; discarded.
